candidates.rationale: By wrapping the click action and page.waitForResponse in Promise.all, the test deterministically waits for the asynchronous API/data request to complete before checking the DOM result.
Explicitly waiting for the result element to become visible and applying an extended assertion timeout ensures the UI has fully updated after the asynchronous load completes.
